diagnostic_assessment.scope: Rank R-hat, bulk/tail ESS and divergences only; inspect mixing, PPC, priors and identification separately. Sample-count screens are operational, not universal guarantees.

future_projection.reason: Adapter exposes historical responses only; future baseline/carryover semantics not implemented and verified

optimization.reason: Native optimizer integration and uncertainty propagation not verified; no Ridge fallback

calibration.reason: Conditional bootstrap reweighting only; not a full experimental refit

multigeography.reason: Current API is one national time series

causal_recommendation.reason: Não há evidência suficiente para sustentar uma recomendação de investimento confiável com os dados e as condições atuais.
